title: Video codec: lossless DPCM intra encoder / decoder of 8-bit frames over AXI4
features: Four 8-bit samples per word, byte 0 first; LEN words from SRC to DST.
Predictor: the previous sample of the job (mod 256); 128 for the first sample of the job and, when LINE_WORDS != 0, of every line of LINE_WORDS words.
MODE 0 ENCODE: out = (x - pred) mod 256. MODE 1 DECODE: out = (in + pred) mod 256, pred = the decoded sample. DECODE(ENCODE(frame)) = frame.
ZEROS counts zero residuals (ENCODE: output bytes, DECODE: input bytes), saturating.
CHECKSUM is the 32-bit sum of the frame words (ENCODE: input, DECODE: output), so both directions of one frame give the same value.

fields.desc: first word read by the job
first word written by the job
32-bit words (0: the job ends at once)
start a job with the current registers; ignored while busy
the current / last job saw an AXI error response (cleared by start)
zero residuals of the current / last job
clocks from start to DONE of the current / last job

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a job ended that saw an AXI error response

sequence: Write SRC_ADDR, DST_ADDR (word aligned) and LEN (32-bit words).
Write CTRL with the job's options and IRQ_ENABLE with DONE (and ERR).
Wait for irq (or poll STATUS.busy = 0), read the result registers, write 1s to IRQ_STATUS to clear it.
notes: m_* is the AXI4 manager port (32-bit address and data, 4-bit ID, no user / QoS); it passes through unchanged. Bursts are INCR, AxSIZE = 2 (4 bytes), 1 to 16 beats, WSTRB = 4'hF, never across a 4 KB boundary; one read and one write burst are outstanding at a time. A read burst is issued only when its data has room, a write burst only when all its data is ready.
